title: ICAN Graro Gravel Frameset - I'm Late to the Party!

takeaways.text: Aggressive, road-like geometry: the presenter chose a 54 although his height suggests a 56, to avoid slamming the stem; 45 mm tire limit; wide T47 (86.5 mm) and UDH, with mechanical groupsets also supported.
Retail price was US$899 for the frameset in September 2026, in a new gloss-silver colour.
Supplied by ICAN. Size 54 frame weighed 1,111 g with mounting bolts fitted, uncut fork 455 g, seatpost 171 g and the integrated gravel cockpit 399 g.
Caliper mounts and the bottom-bracket shell were cleanly faced and the finish looked premium on this media sample, though he notes it may not represent customer frames.

disclosure: Patrick Lino says ICAN sent the frameset; the description lists affiliate and discount codes for several brands.
summary: First look at a 54 cm Graro frameset in the 2026 gloss silver finish: weighed frame, fork, seatpost and integrated cockpit, geometry and sizing remarks, mechanical-groupset compatibility and finish quality before the build.
